about_the_game:
Transmission in Progress is an innovative first-person time management murder mystery game, you will have to allocate your time between multiple different simultaneous events and use careful logic and deduction in order to unravel the truth of the case.

"The deceased is Eratos, Chief of Police, 43 years of age. Cause of death is believed to be a gunshot to the chest. Time of death is estimated to be at 8:30. Click. That should do it, let's get started..."

Seeing as you ARE new to the job, here is a quick rundown of your main tasks for this case:

  • Listen to several different conversations happening live, and remain vigilant to any useful keywords you might hear.

  • Highlight any visible words in your environment, keep them accessible.

  • Find the relations between the selected words using your red string conspiracy board. 

  • Deduce the true culprit behind the murders and bring them to justice.

Feel free to take some time and ruminate on things before you make any conclusions! If you need a break, you may wander the room, but please do not leave -- after all, we are somewhat understaffed right now, we took the effort to set everything up in your hospital room because we need this case solved as soon as possible.

content_descriptors.notes:
Transmission in Progress is a detective and murder mystery game, as such, it features written depictions of murder, injuries and violence.

None of these are visually displayed in the game, as they are purely text-based descriptions.

short_description: Transmission in Progress is a detective game located in a sound powered world, playing in the shoes of Inres, a forensic detective falsely accused of murder. You must tap into several different audio channels to determine the real suspect of the crimes you were falsely accused of.
